//overrides_rationale: node-domexception@1.0.0 is deprecated upstream and has no replacement version. fetch-blob@3.x and 4.x both still declare it as a hard dep. We override to a local stub that re-exports globalThis.DOMException (native in Node 18+). Remove this override + the stubs/ directory once mediasoup ships a release pulling node-fetch@^4 stable, OR fetch-blob ships a version that drops the polyfill dep entirely.
//overrides_security: ws@^8.21.3 closes GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p (memory-exhaustion DoS; transitive via socket.io->engine.io->ws, vulnerable <8.21.0). Raised from a former ^8.21.0, which sat EXACTLY on that advisory floor with no headroom; engine.io and socket.io-adapter both declare ~8.20.1, which resolves 8.20.1 and is vulnerable, so this override is load-bearing and its two baseline rows are deliberate. @babel/core@^7.29.7 closes GHSA-4x5r-pxfx-6jf8 (arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL; transitive via @vitest/coverage-istanbul). brace-expansion@^5.0.9 closes GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp (exponential-time expansion DoS), GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (unbounded expansion -> OOM crash, first patched in 5.0.8 on the 5.x line; 2.x at 2.1.3) and GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 (DoS via unbounded intermediate arrays, bypassing the CVE-2026-14257 mitigation; first patched in 5.0.9 on the 5.x line; 2.x at 2.1.4); all three transitive via eslint->minimatch. nanoid@^3.3.17 closes GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 (custom generators loop indefinitely when size is zero; transitive via vite->postcss). socket.io-parser@~4.2.7 closes GHSA-2m8v-j782-fhvr (zero-attachment memory exhaustion; transitive via socket.io) — this one and ws are the only RUNTIME entries in this block, brace-expansion and nanoid both resolve dev-only. It was reachable pre-auth: the decoder runs on Client.ondata before the namespace auth middleware, so a 0-attachment BINARY_EVENT header installed a reconstructor that never cleared and accumulated buffers unbounded, and maxAttachments does not bound it because that gates the DECLARED count. TILDE, not caret: socket.io declares ~4.2.4, so a caret would force a future 4.3.x wire-format decoder under a socket.io that never declared compatibility with it. Safe here because this package's minimatch (10.2.4) declares brace-expansion ^5.0.2. client/desktop ALSO runs brace-expansion ^5.0.9 now (2026-08-15), having dropped the minimatch@^9 downgrade cap that previously coupled it to the 2.x line; the three workspaces are finally aligned. Read its own //overrides_security note rather than assuming its numbers from here. node-domexception is a file: stub, not a version pin — fetch-blob declares ^1.0.0 and the package is deprecated with no maintained release, so the stub replaces it outright. It is exempt from the override-range lint by design: a stub has no version to compare, so no skew is expressible (see scripts/security/override-range-lint.mjs). These are forced because the intermediates pin older ranges. Drop each override once the parent pulls a patched version natively. VALIDATED 2026-08-15: every entry re-checked against live advisory data and against each consumer's declared range; the only remaining baseline rows here are the two ws consumers above, both forced UPWARD onto a patched version.
